payload.title: /root/effect_iteration_gc_review
payload.result:
Use the per-step MessageChannel experiment before further production optimizations.

- Generator and direct loops preserve Set order, pruning and births. The slowdown does **not** establish a gameplay regression or a proven GC cause.
- The generator’s sampled cost includes Set traversal and `WeakRef.deref`, which direct iteration still performs; removing it cannot be assumed to save the full 12.37%.
- Clock/getter/pose cycles are collectible absent external owners. Queues, physical memberships, completion records and retained playback handles intentionally keep clocks alive. No safe membership-based culling follows.
- Reuse one MessageChannel, allow one outstanding resolver and close both ports in `finally`. Preserve every simulation step, input, provider and test budget.

Port messages create separate tasks; the microtask checkpoint clears kept weak targets after draining. Nested timers instead acquire a 4ms minimum. These support a narrower accelerator experiment, **not deterministic collection or original-runtime scheduling equality**. [Messaging](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/web-messaging.html#message-ports), [microtask checkpoints](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint), [timers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/timers-and-user-prompts.html#timer-initialisation-steps).

No files changed, tests run or processes started.
